verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a GST Developer Portal exists, but only as a landing page with Register/Login/Feedback links. Nothing documents which operations the API exposes, so API parity with the UI cannot be credited. The many help modules describe portal UI workflows and an offline upload tool (registration, return filing, ITC, payments, refunds, appeals), not API equivalents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
